description: Reusable node and branching recipe; not an importable workflow. Copy the node parameters into a workflow with stable orderId/eventId input and configure Continue On Fail output handling.

branches.name: ambiguous write outcome
branches.action: Inspect the card and delivery state before considering any replay. Do not blindly run Create & Deliver again.

branches.name: no write applied
branches.action: Diagnose errorDetails.category/code. A retry is safe only when errorDetails.retryable is true and the workflow applies a bounded retry policy.

operatorReplay.prerequisite: Verify whether the card or delivery already exists before replaying an ambiguous outcome.
operatorReplay.repeatedCreateBehavior: The same outTrackId does not guarantee deduplication or upsert. If verification shows the card exists, use Update rather than Create & Deliver.
